purpose: First isolated React Native preview runtime shell that renders the playback envelope returned by /api/generic-visual-battle-runner-preview/playback-preview as a battle-like UI (HP bars, timeline stepper, hit markers, result summary, safety panel). Deeplink-only, preview-only, no live runtime conversion.

visual_behavior.flag_off: preserves v34 disabled 503 UI; no fake playback rendered
visual_behavior.flag_on: renders deterministic shell from /playback-preview envelope only
visual_behavior.timeline_driver: setInterval visual stepper, no battle simulation
visual_behavior.hp_bars_driver: deterministic replay of precomputed_battle_log up to activeTurn
visual_behavior.hit_markers: display-only damage log row + short border flash
